notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Demo Update[/h1]
The demo has been updated to a more recent version of the game, you can now compete with other people for the first 5 levels on the leaderboards.

Music has also been added to the demo.

notes.title: Development update #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
Leaderboards have been added to the game, this means that you can challenge your friends to try to complete the game in less moves, here an in development version of it currently looks:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32939445/be3701b04002f745b5fb2619c771e88c92acac5e.png[/img]

[h1]Community[/h1]
The Discord community has been growing steadily, if you want to join use this link:
https://discord.gg/XDQjr53

notes.title: Development update #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Community[/h1]
A community is important to a game, if you want to talk about the game, talk about ideas you have for the game or just want to chat with fellow gamers, you can join the [url=https://discord.gg/XDQjr53]Discord[/url].

[h1]Music[/h1]
Music has been added to the game, I have chosen for classical music, this seems to be fitting the game really well.

[h1]Almost All Levels[/h1]
Almost all levels have been created, currently 42 out of the 50 levels have been completed! Here is a picture of the 40th level:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32939445/80823d52396186006837fc44a6ffbd3faf40af8b.png[/img]

[h1]Kickstarter[/h1]
A [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrgoatsy/box-the-game]Kickstarter[/url] has been created for the game, do not worry, no matter the outcome the game will be released, here is the link:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrgoatsy/box-the-game]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrgoatsy/box-the-game[/url]
